title: Senior Trust & Safety Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  
  
**Vultr Cares**

* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Trust & Safety Analyst to process abuse reports, enforce our TOS/AUP, assist in maintaining IP reputation, and pursue brand and intellectual property protection escalations. The ideal candidate is a critical thinker with a strong technical grasp of internet infrastructure (DNS, IPs, networking), an investigative mindset for uncovering abuse patterns, and impeccable judgment to enforce policies fairly and consistently. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require the ability to operate independently within a framework, manage high-volume escalations under pressure, and collaborate effectively with Customer Support, Network Engineering, Security Operations, and other cross-functional teams to mitigate complex threats. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Constant and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Investigate and resolve complex abuse reports and TOS/AUP violations.
* Manage a high volume of tickets and serve as the primary point of contact for customers concerning abuse reports.
* Enforce platform policies consistently and document all actions.
* Monitor and defend IP and network reputation against malicious activity.
* Process intellectual property (DMCA) and brand protection claims.
* Analyze threat patterns to identify emerging risks and trends.
* Collaborate with Network, Security Operations, and Support teams on escalated cases.
* Develop and refine internal policies and playbooks.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 3+ years of experience in trust & safety, abuse management, or a related customer support role.
* Shift Timings : 04:30 PM - 12:30 AM IST.
* Proven experience in cloud computing, hosting, or ISP infrastructure environments.
* Practical knowledge of internet protocols (IP, DNS, HTTP/S) and common attack vectors.
* Strong analytical ability to evaluate data, identify patterns, and make evidence-based decisions.
* Excellent written English skills for clear, professional communication and documentation.

**Inclusion & Privacy**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
  
  
We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
  
  
Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Account Analyst to efficiently manage and assess sensitive account details, including but not limited to credit card fraud, account takeovers, and chargebacks. The ideal candidate is an experienced professional with excellent communication and analytical skills, capable of proactively contributing to team discussions and identifying fraudulent and suspicious account activities. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require you to help maintain a seamless user sign-up process, protect our business from potential risks, and recommend workflow improvements. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Constant and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to and analyze a high volume of risk-related tickets promptly and professionally through written communication, ensuring adherence to Standard Operating Procedures.
* Investigate and assess account activity related to credit card fraud, account takeovers, disputes, and chargebacks to maintain the integrity of the platform.
* Identify and escalate complex or suspicious account activity to the appropriate team for further investigation.
* Document and track risk-related tickets in the ticketing system, ensuring necessary details are logged.
* Maintain in-depth knowledge of company risk protocols, policies, and services across fraud, abuse, and account verification workflows to provide accurate guidance to customers and teammates.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve risk-related issues.
* Stay current with emerging fraud trends and tactics, identify patterns, and share findings with the team to strengthen detection and prevention strategies.
* Assess operational workflows and provide recommendations to improve operational efficiency in fraud detection processes.
* Mentor and support the professional development of junior Account Analysts, sharing knowledge and expertise to foster growth within the team.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to provide risk-related information and general assistance to customers and teammates.
* Ability to manage a high caseload of risk investigations simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and consistency in decision-making.
* Sound discretion and independent judgment in assessing and resolving complex risk-related issues.
* 3+ years of experience in fraud investigation, account risk, or trust & safety operations, working independently to resolve complex tickets.
* Demonstrated ability to identify fraud trends and recommend workflow improvements.
* Experience mentoring or providing guidance to junior analysts, with sound judgment on when to escalate versus resolve independently.
* Strong analytical judgment with a bias toward evidence-based decisions over reactive account actions.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, to support 24/7 fraud and risk coverage.

title: Engineer - IT
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
  
  
To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add an
**Engineer - IT**
located in Sriperumbudur
  
  
**What a typical day looks like:**

* Support the IT system development projects team for the business.
* Analyze, design, code, and test new systems and system enhancements in line with the deliverables of the IT projects.
* Install, configure, administer, and maintain most complex information systems and associated hardware, in accordance with technical specifications, so that the organization’s information systems function reliably.
* Working with the users to enable you to effectively gather their requirements and allow you to prepare detailed program specifications and then coordinate system implementation.
* Communicate with system users; and investigate, trouble-shoot, and resolve system problems so that user problems are resolved quickly and satisfactorily.
* Develop a testing schedule that fits around the business requirements as well as producing an applicable user manual.
* Provide training and help with bedding in any system development or enhancements made.
* May coach or provide guidance to lower-level support analysts.

**The experience we’re looking to add to our team:**

* Typically requires a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in addition to 2+ years of related experience.
* Experience on SQL server query building, applications and report development.
* Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrates basic functional, technical and people and/or process management skills as well as customer (external and internal) relationship skills.
* Demonstrates skills in functional/ technical area.
* Use of the following tools may be required: Office Skills: telephones, data entry, and office software to include word processing, spreadsheets, and presentation package and database systems.

**What you’ll receive for the great work you provide**

* Health Insurance
* PTO

PV14
  
  
Flex is an Equal Opportunity Employer and employment selection decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. title: MS Specialist Core
description:
**Job Description**
 Nokia Global Delivery operations comprise the NOC Operations (FCAPS) for the global telecom companies from all market segments. CSPs and Enterprise customers are served from the Nokia GDC. This Role will be responsible for end\-to\-end handling of network operations. Providing technical consultation and resolving queries/service tickets/incidents.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Providing technical support for complex Core nodes (Analysis, Troubleshooting \& fixing the issues reported) on already deployed to end customer/user.
* Technical Operations support for Customer Team.
* Manages technical escalations for technical requests, emergency cases and outages internally and towards customer.
* Support customer’s network performance and evolution.
* Manages network SW and HW configuration information.
* Acts as the prime technical interface towards customer, subcontractors and 3rd party suppliers as well as internally towards several organizations.
* Liaise closely with Multiple teams to work on the operation faults and technical management to ensure the Network stability.
* Monitors and reports customer’s life network performance and acts to ensure network’s availability including e.g. customer SLA fulfilment
* Support and perform competence development of local technical teams.
* Ensure multiple network Element are connected and all functions are working well.
* Handling Critical and Emergency network incidents with stakeholders/Care.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-Have:**
* Typically, a minimum experience on Platforms between 7\-10 yrs require
* Require Educational Qualification B.E/B.Tech.
* In\-depth understanding of OpenStack Architecture NFV, Mano \& its components like (component like Nova, Cinder, Neutron, Horizon, Glance, Keystone)
* Live experience in deploying / managing the Cloud Infra using OpenStack.
* System Administration of Linux ubuntu/OpenStack environment
* Storage knowledge like HP, EMC and IBM LUN creation and allocation
* Service deployment using the Virtualization, Orchestration, Image


**Nice\-To\-Have:**
* Linux distributions: Ubuntu, Centos, Red hat New installation and trouble shoot.
* Storage knowledge like HP, EMC and IBM LUN creation and allocation
* Understanding of SDN and VLAN and overlay (VXLAN, MPLSGRE etc.)


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working schemes
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
* Life insurance to all employees to provide peace of mind and financial security
* Well\-being programs to support your mental and physical health
* Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs)
* Employee Growth Solutions to support your personalized career \& skills development
* Diverse pool of Coaches \& Mentors to whom you have easy access
* A learning environment which promotes personal growth and professional development \- for your role and beyond

title: Security & Facilities
description:
* Monitor and control entry and exit of employees, contractors, visitors, and vehicles.
* Ensure effective gate management and verification of IDs, permits, and material movement documents.
* Conduct regular security patrols across fabrication shops, laydown areas, warehouses, jetty, and yard premises.
* Prevent theft, pilferage, trespassing, vandalism, and unauthorized activities.
* Monitor CCTV systems, access control systems, and security alarms.
* Maintain records of personnel movement, visitor passes, vehicle logs, and incident reports.
* Verify material inward and outward movement in coordination with Stores, Logistics, and Project teams.
* Support emergency response activities during fire, medical emergencies, natural calamities, and security incidents.
* Investigate security breaches and prepare incident reports with corrective actions.
* Coordinate with local authorities, police, coast guard, and emergency response agencies when required.
* Supervise contract security personnel and ensure discipline, deployment, and shift management.
* Conduct security awareness programs and toolbox talks for employees and contractors.
* Ensure compliance with company security procedures, statutory regulations, and HSE requirements.
